content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe offers a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-every-detail-you|payments]] platform with 46 country coverage, but it's not available in 149 countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. PayPal provides a payments platform with a broader reach, but its account suspension policy can hold funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer digital sales platforms, but they're restricted in certain countries, and Paddle is not available in many regions. These platforms are not designed to be a permanent solution for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-trap-most|The How]] in restricted countries – they're a band-aid fix.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries, but its restricted countries list is long and ever-changing. PayPal's account suspension policy can affect creators in any country, regardless of its availability. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have restrictions, but they're not transparent about their country coverage. Paddle is not available in many regions, and its creators are left in the dark. This lack of transparency and reliability makes it difficult for creators to plan and operate their businesses in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's payment processing fees range from 2.4% + 30¢ per transaction, while PayPal's fees can be up to 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge fees ranging from 3.5% to 8% per transaction. Paddle's fees are not transparent, making it difficult for creators to budget and plan. In contrast, NOWPayments and CoreMerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer creators the ability to own and control their infrastructure, automate payment processing, and deliver products directly to customers. This level of automation and control is essential for creators who want to scale and succeed in restricted countries.
